categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-efficiency lithium battery cathode materials, including ternary cathode materials (with self-supplied precursors), lithium iron phosphate, lithium cobalt oxide, and spherical nickel. Its products serve the power battery, energy storage, and consumer electronics sectors, forming a comprehensive product system. The company also operates in precursor materials production and battery recycling, forming a vertically integrated supply chain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in ternary cathode materials, including high-nickel, single-crystal, and high-voltage products, with proprietary precursor synthesis and cathode material preparation techniques. It employs a 'demand-driven, digital-driven' lean production system with full-process quality control. R&D focuses on next-generation materials such as high-nickel, lithium-rich manganese, solid-state, and semi-solid-state battery materials, supported by over 160 patents and multiple innovation platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading lithium battery manufacturers such as CATL, EVE Energy, and Sunwoda, serving primarily the new energy vehicle (NEV) and energy storage markets. The company’s products are used in electric vehicles, energy storage systems, power tools, drones, and aerospace applications. The domestic Chinese market dominates sales, with growing international market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Hunan Province. It has strategic partnerships and supply agreements extending to international markets including Japan, France, and other parts of Europe and Asia. The company is expanding its global footprint through overseas capacity and technology deployment.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the lithium battery supply chain, producing cathode materials and precursors. It integrates upstream resource access through investments in mining and raw material suppliers and extends downstream into battery recycling and reuse, forming a closed-loop supply chain from raw materials to recycling.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the dual-driver business model of ternary and lithium iron phosphate cathode materials, advancing high-nickel and single-crystal technologies, and accelerating next-generation battery materials like solid-state and sodium-ion batteries. The company emphasizes innovation through collaboration with universities and research institutes, expanding R&D personnel, and increasing R&D investment to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithium battery cathode materials and precursors to battery manufacturers. The company also earns income from government subsidies related to technology development and environmental initiatives. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on product sales and strategic partnerships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the lithium battery cathode materials industry, ranking among the top suppliers of ternary cathode materials in China. It competes with major industry players like CATL, EVE Energy, and Sunwoda. Its integrated precursor and cathode material production and strong R&D capabilities provide competitive advantages in technology and supply stability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.54 billion, a 48.37% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 507.58 million. The decline was due to market demand shifts, increased competition, and raw material price fluctuations. Despite short-term setbacks, the company maintains substantial total assets of RMB 12.85 billion and continues investing in capacity expansion and R&D for long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high safety, high energy density, and long cycle life in its cathode materials, supported by advanced technology and rigorous quality control. Its vertically integrated supply chain from raw materials to recycling ensures stable supply and cost advantages. The dual-driver strategy of ternary and lithium iron phosphate materials, combined with innovation in next-generation battery technologies, differentiates it as a reliable and forward-looking supplier in the new energy materials industry.
